children: PPG Industries reported third-quarter 2026 net sales of $4.35 billion, up 6.6% from the prior-year quarter. Net income was $456 million, up 2%, while diluted EPS increased 1% to $2.02. Growth reflected higher prices and volumes, favorable currency and acquisitions.

¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net income attributable to controlling and noncontrolling interests”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per common share (attributable to PPG) - assuming dilution”.
Sales grew across all regions, led by Asia Pacific, up 10.2%, and Latin America, up 9.6%.
Performance Coatings sales rose 9.9%, and segment income increased 22%, supported by aerospace and refinish momentum. Aerospace demand and backlogs remained strong.
Industrial Coatings sales grew 5.3%, including double-digit growth in packaging, while segment income fell 14% amid cost inflation.
For the fourth quarter, PPG expects low-to-mid-single-digit organic sales growth in Performance Coatings and flat-to-low-single-digit growth in Architectural.
